first_reader_check.about: Whether a published tag on a released mathematics item (a standard code, or a cognitive domain) is required to match the key, tested by programs that lack the tagged operation, with no student data.
first_reader_check.shown: Item-writing rules yield no family-wise discovery; one rule beats chance on two cells and awaits replication. Claimed rows are measured on items re-read from the page image, the language-model rows only where a second independent transcription agrees. Language models of two families recover New York Regents Algebra I and Algebra II keys with the given quantities withheld, and the recovery survives a change of every option value with the form kept. On items two independent codings of item demand mark as requiring computation on the givens, one of three scorers misses the bar, so the claim is that a pass on the matched items does not require the given quantities, not that it omits the tagged operation. The international cognitive-domain cells yield no such program at about 50 to 80 public items each.
first_reader_check.what_is_new: A one-sided program witness on tagged public mathematics, hashed before scoring and Holm-corrected inside three families; a measurement layer in which the released text is replaced by two independent page transcriptions rather than filtered; two blind item-level codings of item demand joined to the rows; and an option-value control that covers every scorer without a reproduction floor.
first_reader_check.why_a_big_deal: Accountability and research read a tagged pass as evidence of the tagged competency. Where a program without the given quantities matches the key on both Regents algebra cells, on every scorer, and with the option values changed, that reading is of the wrong quantity on those items. The text layer of released forms differs from the print on about half the items, so any census of released items that does not re-read the page is measuring a proxy.

Algebra I and Algebra II in two model families
the recovery survives a change of every option value with the form kept (true for all three scorers on both cells, Table tab:isomorph)
execution statement not made: one of three scorers misses the bar on items both codings mark as requiring computation on the givens (Table tab:verbclass)

first_reader_check.no_conjunction_contradicted_by_a_table: The abstract conjoins Algebra I and II recovery with survival under the option-value change; Table tab:isomorph shows every scorer clearing on both cells under the rank-preserving arm. It does not conjoin recognition-tagged carry with isomorph survival (the N2 objection).
first_reader_check.title_and_subtitle: unchanged; the catalog and image-backsolve rows still match keys with programs that lack the tagged operation

first_reader_check.intro_and_captions: Contribution bullet 2 states the two-transcription verification as part of the bar. Contribution bullet 4 names the rule (second-smallest numeric option), expands EQAO on first use, states Algebra I and II on two families with the option-value survival on all three scorers, states the two codings and the one scorer that misses the execution subset, and gives the claim as information not operation; the sentence about a row being dropped in an earlier revision was removed because a cold reader has no earlier revision. Results opens with a three-sentence layer paragraph so the first table a reader meets (tab:repaired) is the claimed population. Captions of tab:repaired, tab:verbclass, tab:isomorph, and tab:witnesses gloss masked-stem, repaired verified, repaired all, cluster tag versus both coders, and the isomorph, and each names which rows clear. The Algebra II paragraph in Results states the filter failure and the repaired-layer clear as a fact about layers, not about a previous draft.
